scope: Independent source grouping-marker equality for gathered user actuals only.
checks: Call owner identity/line/column comes from independent producer AST, not guarded IR; existing callee binding/type checks remain before actual matching.
Written ordinal j is retained while formal k is remapped by keyword. The helper scans ordinal j and confirms its producer-derived keyword before reading the first value token.
Only lexer TK_OPERATOR punctuation controls delimiter nesting, commas, grouping and continuation markers. CHARACTER literals/comments cannot masquerade as punctuation.
Nested parentheses and square constructors are tracked; legacy (/ /) constructor tokens are separate lexer operators, so parentheses nesting also protects those commas.
Whitespace/newline/comment/& tokens are skipped only at actual leading-token positions; parentheses after keyword/continuation are detected without evaluating source values.

Bound calls have implicit passed object removed from both expected/source actual lists; source ordinal remains explicit-written ordinal. Supported bound receivers are whole scalar variables, so no receiver subscript parentheses precede the actual list.
Grouping equality is checked before eligible bare-gather admission, closing both strip-parentheses and forged-parentheses public-IR adapter paths; no parser/runtime/vendor behavior is modified.
No broader intrinsic/ordinary-expression marker semantics are introduced. Numeric gathered user actuals retain their existing parenthesized rule.
limits: Read-only review; no builds or native/candidate execution performed for this followup.
Ten source controls already observed by author on pre-fix preview; pending central native60/71 must prove both marker mutation directions and exact-source acceptance after compilation.
